items.headline: Anthropic Shares Rise On Nasdaq After Record IPO
items.excerpt: The offering promises to be the public market event of the season, with the Claude creator seeing investor demand for shares well in excess of its capital-raising goals.

items.headline: The Key Numbers I’m Watching As Anthropic Makes Its IPO Debut
items.excerpt: Just three years after launching with zero revenue, Anthropic brought in $17 billion and says more than 11,900 customers now spend at least $100,000 a year. But its IPO filing also reveals enormous computing commitments and big questions about balancing growth with risks.

items.headline: Sector Snapshot: Investors Turn Up The Volume On Voice AI
items.excerpt: Voice AI is drawing billions of dollars from investors as startups find more ways to put it to work. According to Crunchbase data, companies developing or offering the technology have raised at least $9.5 billion in venture funding so far in 2026.

items.headline: Genesis AI Raises $500M At $3.5B Valuation To Bring Its Robots To Factories And Warehouses
items.excerpt: Genesis AI, a startup teaching robots to perform physical tasks by learning from human movements, announced Tuesday it has raised $500 million in Series A funding at a $3.5 billion valuation.
